Hi Marissa / Alex,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the ability to pin model versions. We'd like to lock in the mutual action plan and confirm the paperwork timeline so we can start the pilot on Feb 10.

I've attached our consolidated MAP (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf) and a draft SOW (Orbital_SOW_Rdwd_2026.docx). High-level asks from our side:
- Final legal review complete by Feb 2
- Term sheet signed (DocuSign) by Feb 4 to allow internal procurement+PO
- Pilot start: Feb 10 (2-week evaluation window)

Can you confirm you can meet that cadence? Also curious whether Redwood needs any pre-deployment runbook from our infra/NetOps.

Thanks,

Head of AI Engineering | Orbital AI

Rachel / Nitin — final confirmation from our side: GREEN on the proposed cadence. Summary below and action items with owners/timing — please treat this as the single source MAP for the pilot launch.

Mutual Action Plan (final):
- Jan 31 (completed): Redwood delivered pre-deploy runbook + evaluation plan (Alex)
- Feb 2: Redwood legal internal signoff (Aditya) — completed with two clarifications
- Feb 3: Term sheet routed via DocuSign (Marissa) — DocuSign envelope sent: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d
- Feb 4: Target signature deadline (Orbital) — requested to allow procurement & PO issuance Feb 5
- Feb 9: Reserved eval capacity provisioned (Redwood)
- Feb 10: Pilot start (both teams) — 2-week evaluation; checkpoints on Feb 17 and Feb 24

Data and legal clarifications (Aditya):
- Retention: logs 90 days, KV cache ephemeral unless explicit opt-in (acceptable to Orbital?)
- Data isolation clause appended to SOW (see attached term_sheet_for_signature.pdf)

Paper process / final go/no-go:
- DocuSign link above is the authoritative term sheet for signature. Once signed, please email marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com with PO number and intended invoice start date.
- Final go/no-go for production conversion will be a separate mutual evaluation and commercial discussion after the pilot; this thread is strictly pilot onboarding & signoff.

Requested confirmations from Orbital: please confirm by EOD Feb 4 on (1) signature on the DocuSign envelope, (2) acceptance of retention and isolation clarifications, and (3) expected PO issuance date.

If anything changes on timing we should escalate to Aditya immediately to keep the Feb 10 window.

Thanks — looking forward to starting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
